publication.eligibility_criteria: We included studies that reported cross-sectional associations between HairGC and measurements of obesity. We excluded case reports, animal studies, review articles, non-English or nonpeer reviewed studies, and studies in which hair sampling and weight measurements were not performed simultaneously (Figure 1). Pediatric studies that only included children younger than age 2 years were also excluded because BMI-based definitions of obesity are not available for this age group
